headline: Mexico's CFE Prepares $1B Share Sale in Grid Trust for Power Line Expansion
summary: Mexico's state utility CFE is preparing to sell approximately $1 billion in shares of its grid trust, CFE Fibra E, to fund new electricity transmission infrastructure.
why: Comisión Federal de Electricidad (CFE) is Mexico's state-owned electric utility, controlling the national grid and power transmission system.

impacts.name: CFE
impacts.why: CFE is raising capital through its trust to fund expansion of Mexico's electrical transmission grid.
